display_name: OPES O-Car motor vehicle physical damage rules (Decision 124/2019/QĐ-TGĐ, amended by the supplementary clauses of Decision 17/2022/QĐ-TGĐ): cover, exclusions, valuation, settlement, deductible, reductions, termination and deadlines

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of ../../source/raw/opes-ocar.txt, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check finds verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md maps each Vietnamese term to its identifier.

source.authority: the insurer's own published product rules (private contract terms, not law)

scope: The whole document. Encoded: Articles 1.1, 1.8-1.10, 1.15; 2.1, 2.3; 3.1-3.2 with every refund; the deadlines of 4.2, 5.2 and 6 as regulative rules; 7; 8; 9; 10 (claims, complaints, suits); 11.1-11.2; 12 chapeau and 12.1-12.24; 13.2 with its table; 14.1-14.3.2; 15; 16 (as the reductions open to the Insurer, with the one-reduction rule); 17; the supplementary clauses BS01-BS07 and their general conditions; personal data clause 7(b), 9 and 10; and a composing module for the amount payable. Inert: the contents, headers, the role definitions 1.2-1.7 and 1.11-1.14, 2.2, the rights in 4.1 and 5.1 and the duties of 4.2 and 5.2 that restate another article, 13.1, 14.1.2(e), 14.3.1, 14.3.3, the forum clause, personal data clauses 1-6, 7(a) and 8. Out of scope: the back cover, an image with no text layer. Two versions: the 2019 rules and the 2022 supplementary clauses, chosen by the date the contract was concluded. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: The version is the one in force when the contract was concluded.
forks.F2: Each Decision is in force from its date; Articles 1-17 as printed are the 2019 text.
forks.F3: The personal data clause applies where the contract says so, never before 17/04/2023.
forks.F4: The double-insurance share is applied on top of the under-insurance ratio.
forks.F5: A 2019 contract listing BS01 has the clause 14.1.2(c) names; other clauses are declined.
forks.F6: An insured event is any event within the cover, paid or not.
forks.F7: A period counted from day X does not count day X.
forks.F8: Working days are a calendar the caller supplies.
forks.F9: Months from month A to month B are B minus A.
forks.F10: Time in use in 13.2 and 14.1.2(b) is 1.15's, to the contract month.
forks.F11: Refunds are pro rata by calendar days.
forks.F12: 2.3: benefits pass by default; the refund is 3.2.2's.
forks.F14: 3.2.2 with the premium not fully paid is declined.
forks.F15: BS03 and BS05 deductibles replace 15.2's on losses resting on them.
forks.F16: No causal link beyond each exclusion's own words.
forks.F17: Sudden and unforeseeable is required of every peril but a natural catastrophe.
forks.F18: 11.2 costs are added after the ratio, deductible and reduction, inside the cap.
forks.F19: The sum-insured cap is per loss.
forks.F21: BS03 prevails over 12.13 on a flood-water loss.
forks.F22: The 13.2 table applies to (i); (ii) uses the customs rate.
forks.F23: 13.2(ii) is a vehicle imported after use abroad.
forks.F24: A contract deductible below 500,000 is raised to it.
forks.F25: No deductible on a total loss.
forks.F26: Five working days' silence under 5.2 counts as approval for 16.1.3.
forks.F27: 16.1.5 counts children; a mixed vehicle by the higher overload.
forks.F28: The first year of use is the calendar year of first registration.
forks.F29: 14.1.2(d) prevails: a battery is depreciated under BS01.
forks.F30: A kept wreck reduces the indemnity by the Insurer's share of its value.
forks.F31: Order: Article 14, Article 9 share, deductible, one reduction, 11.2 costs, cap.
forks.F32: The 24-hour theft notice runs from when the Policyholder learns of it.
forks.F33: One year is the calendar anniversary; excused delay is added.
forks.F34: When a dispute arises is an input.
forks.F35: BS06 is outside the sum-insured cap.
forks.F36: 16.2: the ground with the highest ceiling, at a rate in its range, or none.
forks.F37: A theft without a judgment or decision pays nothing yet.
forks.F38: Article 7: any difference in the conclusion moves the costs.
forks.F40: The last day for paying the premium is covered.
forks.L1-L8: Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15: Articles 24, 31(1), 26, 52(2), 30(2), 49(1), 53(2), 26(1); recorded in NOTES.md section 3, not encoded.
